text:
oliver grant: Hey @people-ops planning a short 6-week remote stint in Reykjavik (2025-03-01 to 2025-04-12). Quick check: 1) Is WFH stipend prorated for a 6-week stay? 2) Any payroll/tax nexus risk for Redwood for ~42 days in Iceland? 3) Can IT ship a power adapter and SIM to the Airbnb? 4) Will health benefits remain active?
maya (people-ops): Thanks Oliver, please file the Temporary Homebase form. Stipend: prorated by calendar days. Payroll/legal need to triage nexus for Iceland. For shipping choose "international ship" and our vendor will try to handle VAT. Benefits generally continue while on US payroll but confirm specifics.
oliver grant: Form submitted, attached dates and temp address. Role while abroad: internal infra, no client meetings, no recruiting.
sanjay (payroll): Iceland is usually low risk for short stays but we will run a nexus check; 42 days typically below residency thresholds. Don't change bank details until payroll confirms.
nora (legal): Looping legal. Note: Icelandic social security and employer rules can be strict if local contracting occurs. Since you said no client work, risk is low; opening an advisory with tax counsel to confirm.
maya (people-ops): Logistics: IT can send a local SIM and EU/Nordic adapter via vendor. If vendor cannot ship, request pre-approval for expense reimbursement. Keep receipts for any local internet top-ups.
hr-bot: AUTOMATED: Temporary homebase requests must be submitted >=15 business days before travel and include travel dates, temporary address, and required attachments (visa/permit if applicable). https://intranet.redwood/forms/temp-remote
oliver grant: Thanks all 44d please ping when tax/payroll confirm so I can finalize Airbnb.
